intro: The Expo small unit proves that great design fits anywhere. With a compact frame, glass shutters, & a warm dual-tone finish, it lets you display books & décor beautifully—even in smaller spaces.

features.title: Compact design that fits anywhere
features.text: Our small display unit is made for tight spaces—bringing smart storage and beautiful displays to even the coziest corners of your home.

features.title: A mix of open and closed storage
features.text: Showcase what you love on open shelves while keeping clutter neatly tucked away in concealed compartments.

features.title: Clean finish for a warm, stylish touch
features.text: A beautiful cherry finish adds depth and character, making it a perfect fit for modern and classic homes alike.

features.title: Tempered glass shutters for protection
features.text: Our sleek glass panels keep dust away while letting your collection shine, giving your space an elegant and polished look.

features.title: Silent-closing drawers for everyday ease
features.text: We’ve added Ebco bumpers to ensure smooth, quiet closing—so you can enjoy effortless storage without the noise.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
